summary: DockerImages fa83aec (phase/030-P12, not pushed) adds docs/registry-management/delete-repository.md, the D3 procedure: DELETE each distinct tag digest through the API, rm -rf the repository directory in the registry pod, and check the catalog. It runs no garbage collect. Live evidence shows manifest deletes are enabled (registry-cleanup's DELETEs return 202), so RegistryDeploy needs no change. Step 1 was dry-run read-only against the live registry. Close-out A5 records that DockerImages main must carry P11 before the deletion.
